issues.detail: The Greek verb 'ελεγξει' is in the aorist indicative (past/perfective action), but the Vietnamese translation uses 'sẽ khiến' (will cause/make), which changes the tense to the future.

The Greek 'ελεγξει' (elenchse) means 'to examine', 'to test', or 'to bring to account'. The Vietnamese 'khiến... tự cáo' (make [them] confess/accuse themselves) changes the nature of the action from an examination/testing by Him to a self-confession by the world.
